A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same FS-KAN research work and complete 28-page documents, including Appendices A–E. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable comparison of the text, equations, figures, and tables.

before.justification: v2 reports original signal-classification, ModelNet40, continual-learning, and rating-prediction results in Section 5, plus learned-function examples and experimental analyses in Appendices C–D.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark comparisons, continual-learning outcomes, runtime and memory measurements, and the appendix hyperparameter study.

M1.justification: The FS-KA construction, efficient variant, feature-channel handling, and extensions to direct-product groups and higher-order tensors are unchanged in Section 3 and Appendix A.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same synthetic formula and signal tasks, ModelNet40 classification and continual-learning scenarios, and MovieLens-100K, Flixster, Douban, and Yahoo Music rating tasks. No training or evaluation coverage changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments: DSS/scaled DSS for signals, DeepSets/Point-Transformer/standard KAN for point-cloud classification, and SSEM/scaled SSEM for ratings. The separate continual-learning comparison also retains its original models.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendices C–D retain identical splits, preprocessing, sample sizes, model configurations, training budgets, metrics, and testing procedures, including the two-phase continual-learning protocol.

E4.justification: The learned-function interpretability examples, catastrophic-forgetting evaluation, efficiency comparisons, and Appendix D study of depth, width, and spline grid size are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions specify five random seeds and report means with standard deviations. Table 4 retains the same runtime measurement over ten steps; no repeated-run or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted trends, and learned-function visualizations are unchanged, including the appendix results. For example, Table 6 reports FS-KAN accuracy of 0.837 ± 0.007 on full ModelNet40 in both versions.

T1.justification: Propositions 1–8, Corollary 4.1, and the mathematical constructions, complexity derivations, lemmas, and proofs in Appendices A–B are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about arbitrary permutation symmetries, expressivity equivalence with parameter-sharing networks, and advantages in low-data regimes.

C2.justification: Interpretations of interpretability, data efficiency, and computational tradeoffs are unchanged. The conclusion retains the computational-cost limitation and open questions about generalization, optimization, and scalability.

D1.justification: Appendix C retains identical architectures, optimizers, NVIDIA V100 hardware, hyperparameters, data-processing instructions, and implementation-library information. Code and data access information is unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference list, related-work discussion, and positioning relative to earlier equivariant networks and KANs are unchanged.

P1.justification: Limited editorial changes repair caption references and update the version/date stamp. Section 7 removes the Robert J. Shillman Fellow description and adds Schmidt Futures chair support; the narrative and section structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1 and 2 replace unresolved '??' references with panel labels, and Figure 3 changes 'b' to '(b)'. These produce small caption reflows; the illustrations, plots, tables, and their placement are unchanged.

improvement.justification: Repairing the unresolved panel references in Figures 1 and 2 makes the central function-sharing illustrations easier to follow, while Figure 3 gains consistent panel-reference formatting. This provides a limited readability improvement; the scientific content and supporting evidence, including all appendices, are unchanged.
